mechanism_narrative: A continued decline in WORKPLACES mobility indicates fewer commuting-linked discretionary trips, which reduces nearby retail visits with a lag and keeps RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its last-4-week mean over the next 28 days while WORKPLACES does not recover from its current negative level.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL stays elevated and TRANSIT remains deeply negative, households substitute toward at-home activity and avoid downtown shopping, pushing RETAIL_REC down over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT remains below -50 for at least 2 consecutive weekly means
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases within 14 days despite TRANSIT staying below -50 and RESIDENTIAL staying above its baseline.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in PARKS mobility diverts weekend discretionary time toward outdoor recreation, leaving less demand for retail-and-recreation venues and lowering RETAIL_REC in the following week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises above 0 after being negative in the prior week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall in the week after PARKS turns positive from a prior negative week.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both stay far below baseline, the city is in a weak-activity regime that suppresses in-person shopping demand and keeps RETAIL_REC below the prior four-week average over the next month.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT < -50 and WORKPLACES < -30 for 2 straight weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days even though TRANSIT and WORKPLACES remain below the stated thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: A short-run rise in GROCERY_PHARM usually reflects pre-weekend or holiday provisioning that front-loads errands into essential trips, which reduces later retail-and-recreation visits over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases within 14 days after a two-week rise in GROCERY_PHARM.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL rises while PARKS falls, households are spending more time at home and less on out-of-home leisure, which translates into weaker retail footfall over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days even though RESIDENTIAL stays elevated and PARKS remains below baseline.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained recovery in TRANSIT first raises access to commercial areas, then boosts shopping and leisure trips, so RETAIL_REC should turn up over the next four weeks after transit improves.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises by at least 10 points week-on-week from a deeply negative level
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains below its last-4-week mean over the next 28 days despite a clear 10-point TRANSIT improvement.

mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES improves but TRANSIT does not, office reopening is likely partial and car-based, which weakens the spillover to retail demand and leaves RETAIL_REC flat or lower over the next one to two weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES improves while TRANSIT stays below -50
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases within 7 to 14 days even though WORKPLACES rises and TRANSIT stays deeply negative.
